hook: You hosted dinner on your EaDo rooftop
caption: Houston beta party: Jan 9. Cancer hosted a rooftop dinner in EaDo. The date knocked on the wrong identical townhome, the food burned and the mosquitoes came. Best dinner anyway. EaDo or East End?
